title: Reward type
description: One reward TYPE of `public/data/canonical/rewards.json` (ruling `release-r6-rewards-c0` R-R6RC-1, card `release-r6-backend` §5). A character's reward ROW is `sheetData.rewards[]` (release-r4-shapes S2, amended by ADDENDUM 4 with `improvement`); its `key` is this record's `key`, its `tier` one of this record's tier or option keys. STRUCTURE from OggDude Rewards.xml (12 of its 13 keys; JEDI is OUT); EXPLOIT, ACE and TROPHY are corpus-only (`ogg_key: null`). Words are authored plain from the printed pages. Nothing here is a price the app enforces beyond the XP a tier costs: `max_shown` is shown, never enforced (R-R6RC-1).

key.description: S2's `key` (release-r4-shapes S2). The registry's map key equals it.

ogg_key.description: OggDude's RewardKey; null for the three corpus-only types, which export as a receipt row (R-R6RC-4).

kind.description: CLOSED (R-R6RC-1). bought: XP tiers bought in order (Knights of Fate); honour: given, no XP; scar: a Battle Scar (Forged in Battle p.95); reputation: a sphere's level (Keeping the Peace p.92).

title.description: CLOSED (R-R6RC-1): what S2's `name` holds for this type — the person's name, the sphere of influence, the title, the field of expertise, or free words. OggDude's RewardTitle, renamed.

max_shown.description: A number SHOWN beside the type, NEVER ENFORCED: no buy path reads it (R-R6RC-1, rider 4).

choice.description: The OggDude ChoiceKey that S2's `tier` keys into (HONTITLE: the strength choice; its kind choice is `kind_choice`).

kind_choice.description: HONTITLE only: the OggDude ChoiceKey of the title's kind, derived from S2's `skills` and never stored (R-R6RC-2).

talent_choice.description: BS only: the OggDude ChoiceKey of the scar's talent pick (`options`), which the export writes beside the severity; brief release-r6-rewards-followups.

kinds.description: HONTITLE only: each kind's option key and its fixed skill pair (Knights of Fate p.92).

tiers.description: In purchase order. `xp` is the price of THAT tier; S2's `xp` sums the tiers bought. Empty for honours.

options.description: Named picks with no price: the medals, REP's seven levels, the exploits, BS's suggested talents.

effect.description: A type-level effect (Proven Expertise, Maker's Mark); null where the tiers or options carry it, or where the book prints none.

text.description: The type's own rule line, where it has one ('No rule.' where the book says so).

description.description: Authored plain from the printed pages.

contact_result.description: One row of the registry's top-level `contact_results` (ruling `release-r6-ui-c0` U7): Table 3-8, spending a contact network's result, shown on demand after a CONTACT roll (card `release-r6-ui` ADDENDUM 6). Told, never applied.

spend.description: What the roll spends: '2 advantages', '3 threats or a despair'.

oneOf.description: SCHOOL (Q1a): one part per target set, each with its own `targets` and `mods` (Knights of Fate p.95 gives allies/followers and apprentice-aided checks different dice).

key.description: OggDude's OptionKey; null for a corpus-only option.

level.description: REP only; S2's `level` must equal it when `tier` names this option.

suggested.description: BS only: the book's list is a recommendation (Forged in Battle p.95); S2's `talent` may hold any talent.

per.description: How often it fires (Ally/Follower once a session; Title once an encounter).

skills.description: The checks a whole pool rolls (Ally, Follower).

pool.description: A WHOLE pool as printed; read as buildPool({characteristic: ability + proficiency, skillRank: proficiency}) — no second pool builder.

mods.description: Modifiers in the vocabulary talents and items use.

targets.description: SCHOOL only (Q1a): the rewards whose checks `mods` improve.

any_of.description: APPRENTICE (Q1b): pick one arm each turn; an arm with no die vocabulary (melee defence) is TOLD — shown, never applied.

advantage_less.description: MAKERSMARK only (R-R6RC-3): how many advantage the held improvement's cost is lowered by, read live by craftStore's row cost.

advantage_floor.description: MAKERSMARK only: the lowest the lowered cost may go.
